methodology.note: The CDP discovery host (api.cdp.coinbase.com) was unreachable from the network this was run on (TLS reset), so this run measures the PayAI facilitator Bazaar list, which implements the same /discovery/resources spec. *.workers.dev hosts were also unreachable from that network, so sample probes to them show as unreachable, not dead. The INAM-side result (0 agents with a linked wallet) holds for any catalog.

sources.bazaar: https://facilitator.payai.network/discovery/resources (public x402 Bazaar discovery list, GET /discovery/resources paged with limit=100&offset)
sources.inam: https://api.inamprotocol.org/v1/agents/search (public read; supports=erc8004_id lists agents with a linked EVM wallet)

definitions.listing: One discovery item, deduplicated by its resource URL.
definitions.host: Hostname of the listing's resource URL.
definitions.payTo: Every accepts[].payTo across listings; EVM addresses lowercased.
definitions.price: First accepts[] entry, read as USD (6 decimals) only when it is USDC/USDT by extra.name or by a known USDC contract/mint; others are unpriced.
definitions.testnetOnly: Every accepts[] network is a testnet (Sepolia, devnet, testnet ids).
definitions.verifiableTrackRecord: The payTo equals the linked.erc8004_id of an INAM agent, i.e. an INAM ID proved control of that wallet (SPEC.md §2.1). Only EVM addresses can be bound today.
definitions.inamReverseLookup: The registry has no query by wallet. We listed every INAM agent with a linked erc8004_id and intersected.
definitions.dead: Sample probe returned 404/410. Requests that failed (DNS, connect, TLS) or timed out after 15 s are counted separately as unreachable, because the probing network can cause them.
definitions.probe: One unpaid request per sampled endpoint using the method the listing declares (GET if none; '{}' JSON body for non-GET). No payment header is sent.

sample.population: distinct hosts of http listings with an http(s) URL; one random listing probed per sampled host
